resources.string: Diagnostic tools for troubleshooting. Audio output captures are opt-in and never change playback routing.

Records every Android output type as it appears, including types BookWave does not recognize. Shows raw type numbers, current BookWave role, policy-predicted route, capabilities and potential duplicate identities. No device names, Bluetooth addresses, media titles or audio are collected. This session-only capture does not change audio routing. Unknown output means insufficient evidence, not a preferred output.
